description: This file contains Swift test cases for verifying the behavior of 'resolveNixMode' in different scenarios involving UserDefaults and application bundles. It is part of a test suite for the OpenClaw project.

classes.name: NixModeStableSuiteTests
classes.description: A test suite struct for checking Nix mode resolution behaviors within the OpenClaw project.

methods.name: resolves from stable suite for app bundles
methods.description: Tests that 'resolveNixMode' correctly resolves the Nix mode when running within an app bundle with a stable suite UserDefaults.

methods.name: ignores stable suite outside app bundles
methods.description: Ensures that 'resolveNixMode' does not resolve the Nix mode when not running inside an app bundle, even if a stable suite UserDefaults is present.
